latest_release.name: v1.1.13
latest_release.body:
A robustness release: no new features. The fixes below come from a review of the
code, not from reported faults, so most of them you should never notice.

**Patches**

- **A dropped connection inside the head unit can no longer take CarPlay down.** The
  route-guidance hook wrote to a socket that the HMI could have closed already, which
  would have ended the iPhone process.
- **The cluster keeps following you after an internal error.** The task that decides
  what the cluster shows (phone map, maneuver, stock map) used to stop for good on its
  first unexpected error, until the next reboot. It now logs it and carries on.
- **Timers no longer depend on the head unit's clock,** which jumps when the time is
  synchronised. A jump could hold back or cut short the waits around route start,
  route end and reconnecting.
- **The cluster map stream ends cleanly with its CarPlay session,** instead of leaving
  its threads waiting on a connection that is gone, and the hook announces itself
  again if the first attempt was lost.
- **After a route the stock navigation gets its own state back** in one more case
  where the restore could be skipped.
- **Lane guidance and the progress bar take fewer drawing calls** per frame.
- **Cover art:** oversized pictures are refused instead of decoded.
- **Street names** cut at the length limit no longer end in half a character.

**Installer and uninstaller**

- **A stopped install no longer tells you to reboot.** The SD card script now says
  plainly when the installer stopped, and leaves a copy of the log on the card
  (`mod/carplay/last_run.log`) to attach to an issue.
- **Nothing is written before every check has passed.** An unexpected
  `smartphone_integrator.json` or a missing `mm-ipod` used to stop the install after
  the jars were already copied.
- **Files are replaced in one step.** The jars and the config are written beside the
  old file and renamed over it, so an interrupted write cannot leave half a jar on the
  HMI's classpath or a cut-off config.
- **The config backup follows the firmware.** It is taken again on every install from a
  config without the hook, so uninstalling after a firmware update no longer puts the
  old firmware's file back. Uninstall also removes the hook from a backup that already
  carried it.
- **After a firmware update that replaced `mm-ipod`**, the installer saves the new
  binary instead of starting the old one.
- **`NO_RGI` installs also remove the old maneuver pictures** (about 90 MB) left by
  releases before 2026-09-19.
- **`NO_SPORT`, `NO_ETA_DEFAULT`, `NO_MAP_ONLY`** on the card switch those options back
  off; until now that took a cable.
- The route-guidance hook is no longer loaded into the renderers and their supervisor,
  only into `mm-ipod`.

detail.readme:
# MHI2 AU37x CarPlay patches [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay?sort=semver&label=release)](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/total)](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/releases) [![Audi A3 8V | Q2](https://img.shields.io/badge/Audi-A3%208V%20%7C%20Q2-BB0A30?logo=audi&logoColor=white)](#compatibility) [![MHI2 AU37x](https://img.shields.io/badge/head%20unit-MHI2%20AU37x-blue)](#compatibility) [![Apple CarPlay](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apple-CarPlay-black?logo=apple&logoColor=white)](#compatibility) [![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-support-FF5E5B?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/chefranov) [![Donate via monobank](https://img.shields.io/badge/monobank-donate-black)](https://send.monobank.ua/jar/HdecLxjBN) CarPlay additions for Audi MHI2 head units on the **`MHI2_ER_AU37x`** train: - **CarPlay map in the Virtual Cockpit** — the phone's own navigation map (Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze) in the cluster in place of the stock one, 30 fps, decoded by the head unit's video hardware. Follows the cluster's large, Sport and Classic views. - **Route guidance** — CarPlay turn-by-turn maneuvers in the cluster's maneuver tile: the arrow, the distance, the street and lane guidance, drawn live in 3D. - **Cover art** — CarPlay album artwork on the cluster's now-playing widget. - **Touchpad → D-pad** — the MMI touchpad navigates CarPlay menus. - **Maneuver arrow** fills blue as the turn gets closer. For the plain arrow: `touch /mnt/app/rgd_no_arrow_fill` and reboot. - **Phone tab in the cluster** — CarPlay calls in the cluster's phone tab as with a Bluetooth phone: caller, call state and timer, accept, end, hold, mute, recents and favourites, signal and carrier. The **Tel** key and the phone menu go straight to CarPlay, and a **short press of the voice key** starts Siri. - **Parking sensors over CarPlay** — the side sensors open their small popup beside CarPlay instead of taking the whole screen. Installed by default on the firmware it was checked against (P5089, Q2 P5088). Prebuilt binaries, installed from an M.I.B. SD card or over a network cable. > **Use at your own risk.** Everything is reversible, but read > [Recovery](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/wiki/Troubleshooting#recovery) > before you start.

## Compatibility Tested on `MHI2_ER_AU37x_P5089`, `MU1326`, part `8V1035036A` — Audi A3 8V with the Virtual Cockpit and the HARMAN iAP2 stack. Other `MHI2_ER_AU37x_*` builds are expected to work but are not verified: **[read Compatibility before installing](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/wiki/Compatibility)**. Audi Q2 (`MHI2_*_AU276_*`) runs the same HMI classes, and the release is confirmed working on a Q2. The installer checks the firmware train first and stops, changing nothing, on anything that is not `MHI2_*_AU37x_*` or `MHI2_*_AU276_*`. Other trains carry other versions of the HMI classes these patches replace, and installing there can leave the main screen black. If another CarPlay mod is installed on the unit, remove it first. - **CarPlay map in the cluster** needs the iPhone **by cable**; most wireless CarPlay adapters do not pass the cluster stream. Confirmed to carry it: the Carlinkit 2Air with `WIRELESS_MAP` (#25) and the Smart Box `lylink` 2921 with its test firmware 26060215. Zooming with the roller works by cable only. - **Cover art** needs module **17**, adaptation `Picture_Upload_Download` = **active**. - **Route guidance** works with Apple Maps and Google Maps. Waze sends no turn-by-turn data over CarPlay; its map still shows in the cluster. - **D-pad** is self-contained: `bin/dpad_hook.jar` alone in `/mnt/app/eso/hmi/lsd/jars/`. ## Install Download the `…-sd.zip` of the latest release from **[Releases](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/releases)**. What changed in each release is listed there and in the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md). **From an SD card (M.I.B.):** 1. Unpack the archive. It contains a single folder, `mod`. 2. Copy that `mod` folder to the root of an empty FAT32 card. Eject the card safely. Don't drag it over an existing `mod` folder on a Mac: Finder replaces the folder, it doesn't merge them. 3. Insert the card, then in M.I.B. run `Advanced Settings → Run Custom Script`. On M.I.B. V3.6 and later the item is `Advanced Settings → Run individual script`. 4. Read the log on screen, then **reboot the unit** (see below). **Over a network cable:** unpack the archive, then from the folder that contains `mod`: ```sh ssh root@172.16.250.248 'mount -uw /mnt/app; mkdir -p /mnt/app/root/carplay' scp -O -r mod/carplay/* root@172.16.250.248:/mnt/app/root/carplay/ ssh root@172.16.250.248 'sh /mnt/app/root/carplay/install.sh' ``` **Reboot.** The patches load only after a reboot. Hold the button combination for your MMI until the screen goes dark. On the A3/S3 8V that is **NAV/MAP + RADIO + the big rotary knob**. Over SSH: `on -f rcc /usr/apps/mib2_ioc_flash reboot`. Running the installer again upgrades in place. **Before installing, the installer checks:** - **The firmware train.** On anything other than `MHI2_*_AU37x_*` or `MHI2_*_AU276_*` it stops without changing anything. - **Other mods.** It stops if MIBSI, another CarPlay mod, or jars it does not know are on the unit. Remove the other mod first. M.I.B.'s NavActiveIgnore is switched off, and uninstalling switches it back on. | Option | Cable | SD card (empty file in `mod/carplay/`) | |---|---|---| | leave out route guidance and the cluster map | `RGI=0 sh install.sh` | `NO_RGI` | | leave out only the cluster map | `ALTSCREEN=0 sh install.sh` | `NO_ALTSCREEN` | | offer the cluster map to a wireless adapter that does not ask for it | `WIRELESS_MAP=1 sh install.sh` | `WIRELESS_MAP` | | start the line under the maneuver on the arrival time | `ETA_DEFAULT=1 sh install.sh` | `ETA_DEFAULT` | | the cluster map without route guidance (no maneuver tile) | `MAP_ONLY=1 sh install.sh` | `MAP_ONLY` | | install the parking popup beside CarPlay (P5089 and Q2 P5088 only; off by default) | `PDC=1 sh install.sh` | `PDC` | | let unknown jars through | `IGNORE_CONFLICTS=1 sh install.sh` | `IGNORE_CONFLICTS` | `SPORT`, `ETA_DEFAULT` and `MAP_ONLY` stay set across later installs. To switch one back off: `SPORT=0`, `ETA_DEFAULT=0` or `MAP_ONLY=0` by cable, or an empty `NO_SPORT`, `NO_ETA_DEFAULT` or `NO_MAP_ONLY` file on the card. Step by step, and what gets changed on the unit: **[Installation](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/wiki/Installation)**. ## Using it - **Cluster map**: comes up with the phone, after a short intro. A **long press of the left steering-wheel roller** swaps between the CarPlay map and the stock one; the choice survives the ignition. - **Route guidance**: start a route on the phone. A **short press of the left roller** swaps the line under the maneuver between the next street and the arrival time with the time left; to start on the arrival time, `touch /mnt/app/rgd_eta_default` (`ETA_DEFAULT=1` / an empty `ETA_DEFAULT` file at install time). Off without uninstalling: `touch /mnt/app/rgd_disable` and reboot; delete the file to turn it back on. - **Phone tab in the cluster**: with CarPlay it shows the iPhone's calls, recents and favourites. Back to stock ("iPhone in CarPlay mode"): `touch /mnt/app/rgd_no_tel` and reboot. - **Siri**: a short press of the voice key on the steering wheel; a long press works as before. - **Sport layout** is detected by itself. To force it: `touch /mnt/app/rgd_sport` (`SPORT=1` / an empty `SPORT` file at install time). Something not right: **[Troubleshooting](https://github.com/chefranov/mhi2-au37x-carplay/wiki/Troubleshooting)**. ## Uninstall ```sh ssh root@172.16.250.248 'sh /mnt/app/root/carplay/uninstall.sh' ``` or from the card: the release's `…-uninstall-sd.zip`, copied the same way as for the install, and the same M.I.B. menu item. Reboot. ## Support This project is free and stays free. Donations are optional and don't change what you get: [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/chefranov) or [monobank](https://send.monobank.ua/jar/HdecLxjBN). ## Credits - [luka-dev/mib2q-carplay-rgi](https://github.com/luka-dev/mib2q-carplay-rgi) — the HMI patch pattern, the cover-art pipeline, the route-guidance BAP work, the maneuver renderer and lane guidance, the cluster phone tab and Siri, and the parking popup, here ported to the HARMAN iAP2 stack. - [Mich795](https://github.com/Mich795) — cover-art fixes from a version of their own. - [aberbic](https://github.com/aberbic/Audi-MHI2-Virtual-Cockpit-Altscreen-CarPlay-AndroidAuto) — the hardware-decoder layer setup that lit the cluster map.
